newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ambles lower, Sept defends 1,000 stg.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ambles lower, Sept defends 1,000 stg.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures were thinly-traded on Wednesday morning and prices drifted lower with benchmark September keeping the 1,000 stg support intact.
Traders said the bulk of the day's volume of 974 lots was trade-based, with manufacturers holding back awaiting clearer crop picture.
"The (West African) crop development is at the delicate stage right now but no news is a good news," said one trader.
The September contract, which failed to sustain much of Tuesday's sharp gains to end the day about unchanged, spent the morning defending a key support at 1,000 stg.
It finished 15 stg down at 1,002 stg a tonne after a low of 1,001.
But traders said a bigger support lies at 980 stg and then the most recent low of 965.
Tuesday's peak of 1,028 forms the initial resistance, followed by 1,045.
Sept/Dec switches were traded at 36 stg and Dec/March 24-25 stg.
